authority.purpose: reduce operational friction between ethics, licensing, provenance, uncertainty and executable governance without rewriting authorial source material

contract.name: coherence_operational_excellence_providence_contract
contract.rule: unknowns remain explicit TOKEN_VAZIO until a falsifiable gate produces a receipt bound to artifact hash and commit
contract.stop_rule: do not close a gap, promote a claim, redistribute third-party material or assert legal effect when the required evidence boundary is unresolved

source_bindings.epistemic_boundary: authorial declaration; legal enforceability is not inferred
contains symbolic, analogical, mathematical and physical-language claims that require typed downstream status
governance artifact; not legal, scientific or certification proof
progressive engineering controls; conformity and legal compliance claims remain false

license_interoperability.rule: a local LicenseRef improves routing but does not establish enforceability, jurisdiction, compatibility or permission for third-party material

ethics_by_design.rule: ethical symbolism may define governance priorities; it cannot by itself satisfy a physical, statistical, legal or runtime evidence gate

complex_network.edge_rule: every relation names source, target, relation, provenance and claim boundary
complex_network.closure_rule: historical nodes/edges/gaps are append-only; closure is a new receipt event rather than deletion

sequence.operational_meaning: measure observations, distributions, uncertainty and error
name unresolved states explicitly instead of coercing a value
build conceptual bridges while preserving analogy boundaries
type relations, direction, state and next actions
turn intent into an addressable specification
turn specification into an invariant or contract with a falsifier
iterate audited states without deleting prior evidence

parable_router.symbolic_phrase: NENHUM LIMITE E REAL, POIS O CODIGO EXECUTA EM VERBO VIVO -> OMEGA^n
parable_router.runtime_boundary: computational, physical, legal, statistical and resource limits are real operational constraints and must be measured rather than denied

open_tokens.cause: authorial license text makes broad legal-effect statements while repository governance correctly avoids legal-effect claims
open_tokens.evidence_needed: qualified jurisdiction-specific legal review or separate executed instrument for the intended transaction/use
open_tokens.falsifier: review determines that a stated effect, jurisdiction, sanction or acceptance mechanism is not enforceable as written
open_tokens.F_next: keep legal_effect_claim=false and route concrete uses to qualified review rather than treating repository prose as adjudication

open_tokens.cause: custom repository license has no asserted standard SPDX equivalence
open_tokens.evidence_needed: artifact-level rights inventory plus reviewed compatibility mapping for each reuse/distribution route
open_tokens.falsifier: two artifacts have incompatible or unknown redistribution conditions
open_tokens.F_next: use LicenseRef locally, record per-artifact rights and never map to a standard SPDX identifier without evidence

open_tokens.cause: repository-level authorial intent does not establish rights and redistribution conditions for every third-party dataset, paper, code fragment or generated artifact
open_tokens.evidence_needed: machine-readable artifact rights ledger with origin, holder, license/terms, attribution and redistribution state
open_tokens.falsifier: an artifact cannot be traced to a permission/terms record compatible with its intended use
open_tokens.F_next: inventory high-risk distributed artifacts first and block redistribution when rights are unknown

open_tokens.cause: Domain VI uses physical-field language for ethics without a frozen measurable field definition, units, observables, dataset and independent test
open_tokens.evidence_needed: typed measurable variables, units, dynamics, baseline, predictions and falsification experiment
open_tokens.falsifier: the operationalized model fails predictive or stability tests under its declared scope
open_tokens.F_next: retain Ethica[8] as model/ontology until measurable physical content is independently specified and tested

open_tokens.cause: Amor, Verdade, Consciência, Coerência, Liberdade, Responsabilidade, Serviço and Humildade are named but not all have measurable repository-control definitions
open_tokens.evidence_needed: per-dimension metric, scale, input source, uncertainty, adversarial case and decision threshold
open_tokens.falsifier: metric cannot distinguish a compliant control state from a known counterexample without circular scoring
open_tokens.F_next: map each dimension to observable governance controls before using Ethica[8] as an executable scheduler

open_tokens.cause: Domain VI names Phi_ethica as a Lyapunov-function candidate and also uses language implying guaranteed stability without a complete state-domain proof
open_tokens.evidence_needed: defined state domain, differentiable candidate V, equilibrium set, sign conditions and proof or counterexample search
open_tokens.falsifier: there exists an admissible trajectory with dV/dt > 0 or the candidate is undefined/non-positive where required
open_tokens.F_next: downgrade guarantee language operationally to candidate status until a scoped proof receipt exists

open_tokens.cause: the governance graph is specified as a typed network but no dedicated runtime currently computes graph invariants or dependency-impact propagation for this contract
open_tokens.evidence_needed: deterministic graph validator/analysis receipt over this exact registry
open_tokens.falsifier: runtime produces non-deterministic topology, accepts dangling edges or permits unreceipted gap deletion
open_tokens.F_next: execute the repository validator and then add derived graph metrics only if they remain structural rather than truth scores

open_tokens.cause: Ethics-by-Design controls are internally authored and have not been independently reviewed as a complete governance framework
open_tokens.evidence_needed: independent review with conflicts, scope, counterexamples and actionable findings
open_tokens.falsifier: independent review identifies unhandled harms, circular metrics or controls that systematically fail declared objectives
open_tokens.F_next: preserve internal status and invite scoped external review after metrics are operationalized

non_regression_rules: Source bindings are historical provenance and cannot be silently rewritten.
Open TOKEN_VAZIO entries cannot disappear; closure requires an append-only structured receipt with gap_id, artifact_path, sha256 and commit_sha.
PARABOLA and MODELO_ANALOGICO never satisfy scientific, physical, legal or runtime evidence gates by themselves.
LicenseRef is routing metadata and never implies standard-license equivalence or legal enforceability.
Negative, blocked and contradictory findings are first-class records and cannot be deleted to improve appearance.
Graph coverage, node count and edge count are structural metrics, not truth scores.
The phrase 'nenhum limite e real' remains symbolic; operational limits are measured and enforced.
No future revision may set claim_allowed, scientific_confirmation, legal_effect_claim or certification_claim to true without a separate governed authority and evidence route.
F_ok: authorial LICENSE text preserved without destructive legal rewriting
Ethics Domain VI preserved while its operational/scientific boundaries are typed separately
license, ethics, provenance, uncertainty, receipts and parables are connected as a typed complex network
useful unknowns are named as TOKEN_VAZIO with cause, evidence, falsifier, urgency and F_next
parables have an internal routing role without being promoted to evidence
F_gap: runtime receipt for this complex-network contract
F_next: validate this registry fail-closed, run adversarial tests, persist CI receipt, then prioritize P0 rights/legal-boundary and physical-claim gaps without deleting the authorial source text
